name: openlmis-role-rights-dialog
title: Role Rights Dialog
description: Dialog listing what a role lets its holder do, each right named in words, scrolling inside the viewport when the list is long.
docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.
